records.scope: Australian Space Agency-led Roo-ver demonstration on NASA CLPS CT-4 with Intuitive Machines; South Pole region, targeted 2030; no entitlement for other Australian payloads or missions
NASA CLPS CT-4 / Intuitive Machines IM-5

known_gaps.meaning: Replace synthetic Method Lab scenario with frozen adapters from loom_earth, loom_solar, loom_timeline, resource evidence and actor authority.
known_gaps.name: REAL_INPUT_COMPILER

known_gaps.meaning: Versioned actor identity/state separates ownership, operation, scoped access/contracts, capability, experience and spendable allocation with replayable change events.
known_gaps.name: ACTOR_STATE_AND_BUDGETS

known_gaps.meaning: Versioned accessibility separates qualified Solar geometry, scoped actor/provider service access and decomposed generalized cost while preserving FEASIBLE/INFEASIBLE/UNKNOWN.
known_gaps.name: TRANSPORT_ACCESSIBILITY

known_gaps.meaning: Versioned demand/pressure derives scoped requirements from civilization state and explicit commitments, compares them with installed capacity, and carries unmet demand into decaying unit-preserving pressure.
known_gaps.name: DEMAND_AND_PRESSURE_MODEL

known_gaps.meaning: Project Economics V1 provides versioned physical/economic units, uncertainty ranges, scale behavior, technology-year adjustments and provenance; scenario components remain explicitly non-empirical.
known_gaps.name: PROJECT_ECONOMICS

known_gaps.meaning: Mission/Knowledge V1 separates mission actions from infrastructure, actor-visible belief from evaluator truth, keyed noisy observations from physical realization, and deterministic Bayesian knowledge updates from later decisions.
known_gaps.name: MISSIONS_AND_KNOWLEDGE_UPDATE

known_gaps.meaning: Pressure Observability V1 emits immutable annual pressure transitions, quantified causal contributions and per-opportunity qualification traces with stable IDs; selected project decisions link to the exact qualifying record without changing Hybrid behavior.
known_gaps.name: PRESSURE_OBSERVABILITY

known_gaps.meaning: Resource Mass Balance V1 separates actor-visible evidence/belief from evaluator-only physical realization and conserves in-situ stock, extracted feed, grade, recovery, tailings, product inventory and depletion; unquantified abundance remains UNKNOWN rather than zero or invented inventory.
known_gaps.name: RESOURCE_MASS_BALANCE

known_gaps.meaning: Production Accounting V1 separates physical output feasibility from monetary valuation and gross productive-capital accounting; unresolved required constraints remain UNKNOWN, value added is gross output minus intermediate consumption, and operating cost is distinct.
known_gaps.name: PRODUCTION_AND_VALUE_ADDED

known_gaps.meaning: Power Balance V1 separates installed generation capacity from average/firm generation, explicit population/facility load, peak and average demand, annual MWh, reserve/storage assumptions, unserved/curtailed energy and runtime-derived Atlas average/peak load metrics; timeline power milestones never auto-unlock capacity.
known_gaps.name: POWER_BALANCE

known_gaps.meaning: Traffic/Fleet V1 separates local transport handling capacity from realized OD movement and generates explicit cargo/passenger demand assignment, scoped service state, fleet trip capacity, annual voyages, ship calls, backlog, route utilization and node-incidence metrics; unassigned demand remains UNASSIGNED_OD and timeline transport milestones never auto-spawn fleet.
known_gaps.name: TRAFFIC_AND_FLEET

known_gaps.meaning: Module colocation, named facilities, settlements, surface sites, orbital elements and Atlas facility types are not yet materialized.
known_gaps.name: FACILITY_AND_SITE_MATERIALIZATION

known_gaps.meaning: Infrastructure maintenance, depreciation, replacement, failure, retirement and abandonment are not yet production modeled.
known_gaps.name: MAINTENANCE_DEPRECIATION_RETIREMENT

known_gaps.meaning: Cohort demography, births/deaths, synthetic persons, biological viability and long-run settlement demographics are not yet connected.
known_gaps.name: DEMOGRAPHIC_DEPTH

known_gaps.meaning: Economic/transport centrality, strategic significance and other Atlas display metrics must be derived after physical/economic state exists.
known_gaps.name: ATLAS_DERIVED_METRICS

domain_model_boundaries.reason: The qualified LOOM assessment treats Dorrington-Olsen as an asteroid mining mission/economic kernel, not a lunar facility cost or mining-rate model.
The 40-kW-class lunar demonstration objective is used only as the base POWER_PLANT output reference; project cost, lag and learning multipliers remain scenario assumptions.
